class.name: NNActionStateTreeEvent
class.brief_description: Sends an event to a state tree when the action starts.
class.description: An action that sends [member event_name] to the [NNSTRoot] at [member state_tree_path] when it starts, then finishes immediately. The agent never waits on it: the next action step moves past it, so this is the usual way for a behaviour to hand a goal to a state chart and let the chart decide the outcome. An empty [member state_tree_path] targets the nearest ancestor [NNSTRoot], so an agent hosted under a state can signal its own chart. When there is no ancestor chart no event is sent and the action still finishes. An explicit path that does not resolve to an [NNSTRoot] reports an error.

members.member: The name of the event sent to the state tree when this action starts. Empty sends nothing; the action still finishes immediately.

The path to the [NNSTRoot] that receives [member event_name]. The path is relative to this action unless it starts with a [code]/[/code]. Empty targets the nearest ancestor [NNSTRoot]; an explicit path that does not resolve to an [NNSTRoot] reports an error.
